semiconductor_relevance: High — NTS specializes in wafer thinning technology, which is critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in LED and semiconductor fields.
summary: NTS (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. is a leader in nano process technology, providing innovative wafer thinning systems to semiconductor companies globally. Their IWTS (Innovated Wafer Thinning System) has become a standard in the LED thinning equipment market, enhancing yield and reducing costs for their customers.
capabilities: Support services for wafer thinning processes

regional_presence.China: NTS is based in Suzhou, China, and serves over 50 semiconductor companies across 10 countries.
